**STEP 6 - Grams:** Whole fruit bulk density is about 0.55 g/ml, so 350 ml × 0.55 ≈ 190 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Raw apple is about 52 kcal/100 g. 190 g × 0.52 ≈ 99 kcal.
